fusions.name: Cultured Pellet
fusions.desc: Flicks a spore pellet that deals 4 plant damage and leaves the target with Rot for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each tick of the Rot has a 30% chance to be a critical hit.

fusions.name: Perfect Flush
fusions.desc: Releases a ring of spores that deals 28 nature damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and gives them Rot for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Trained Strain
fusions.desc: Restores 12 health and raises your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Habitual Growth
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
